verdict.rationale: Base44 defines backend resources, including agent behavior and tools, in local code and JSONC configuration files. Apps can connect to GitHub for version control, so automations kept as code can be versioned, reviewed and reverted through ordinary git workflows. That is a do-it-yourself path, not a native capability: nothing shows built-in version history, review, or rollback for automations or Superagent workflows. Missing for 10: native automation version history, a review/approval flow for automation changes, one-click rollback, explicit confirmation that workflows and agent configs sync to GitHub, and independent hands-on corroboration.
